newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Palestinians urge boycott of U.S. receptions.
newsitem.headline: Palestinians urge boycott of U.S. receptions.

text.p: Palestinian intellectuals on Monday urged boycotting U.S. Independence Day celebrations later this week in protest at a congressional vote to recognise Jerusalem as Israel's capital.
The calls to stay away from July 4 parties came in a statement signed by unions representing journalists, writers, cultural centres, painters and stage actors.

"The objective of this boycott is to express the public and official outrage of all Palestinians and their institutions, and their rejection of the decision by the American Congress to transfer the American embassy from Tel Aviv to Jerusalem...," the statement said.
The U.S. administration has assured Palestinians that it opposes the congressional decision.
Palestinian intellectuals and officials usually participate in receptions held by U.S. diplomatic missions in Tel Aviv and Jerusalem.

About 50 Palestinians, including Legislative Council members and members of Palestinian President Yasser Arafat's authority, held a demonstration opposite the U.S. Consulate in East Jerusalem to protest against the congressional decision.
